characters.continuity: Harry Potter books and Wizarding World lore (Hogwarts founding era)
characters.summary: Salazar Slytherin was one of the four founders of Hogwarts. He was a Parselmouth with extensive magical ability, especially in Legilimency, and he built the Chamber of Secrets and kept a basilisk there.

techniques: Parseltongue (control of serpents, including the basilisk he kept)

mechanisms: Not established by the cited source

weaknesses: Not established by the cited source

sources.supports: Parseltongue; extensive magical abilities, particularly Legilimency; built the Chamber of Secrets and kept a basilisk in it; snakewood wand with a basilisk-horn core.

feats.claim: Built the Chamber of Secrets beneath the Hogwarts dungeons and kept a basilisk in it.
feats.citation: Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets; Harry Potter Wiki

campaignTags.claim: Founder of Hogwarts with extensive magical abilities.
Wizard with extensive magical abilities, particularly in Legilimency.

unknowns: No recorded duel. The wiki only speculates that he and Gryffindor may have duelled.
Claimed 'Dark Magic' mastery and defensive wards: the cited source does not support them, so they were removed in review.

characters.continuity: Harry Potter books and films (bridge demolition is film-only)
characters.summary: Seamus Finnigan is a Gryffindor and Dumbledore's Army member with a knack for pyrotechnics. He can cast a corporeal fox Patronus, and he fought in the Battle of Hogwarts.
weaknesses: Prone to accidental fires and explosions when casting (e.g. setting a feather alight in first year)
limitations: Early spellwork often misfired into accidental fires

sources.supports: Pyrotechnics ('particular proclivity for pyrotechnics'), accidental fires, fox Patronus, Dumbledore's Army, assigned to destroy the Wooden Bridge and fought in the Great Hall during the Battle of Hogwarts, childhood broom flying.

feats.claim: In the Battle of Hogwarts, he was assigned to destroy the Wooden Bridge to stop Snatchers reaching the school.
feats.citation: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows – Part 2 (film)

feats.claim: Fought in the Great Hall during the Battle of Hogwarts and cast a corporeal fox Patronus.
feats.citation: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows

campaignTags.claim: Hogwarts-trained wizard and Dumbledore's Army member.
Casts combat spells and a corporeal Patronus.

unknowns: Power level compared with adult professional wizards.
Shield-charm proficiency: claimed, but not shown in the cited source, so removed.

techniques: Not established by the cited source (commands Aurors rather than fighting personally)

mechanisms: Not established by the cited source

weaknesses: Not established by the cited source

characters.continuity: Harry Potter books and films (adult Snape, 1991-1998)
characters.summary: Severus Snape was a Potions master, a highly skilled Occlumens and Legilimens, and the inventor of Sectumsempra and Levicorpus. He learned to fly without a broom, and he could block a determined Harry Potter with ease.

mechanisms: Blocks and deflects incoming spells (vs Harry, 1997)

weaknesses: Pride: becomes furious when pitied or called a coward, which Harry's taunt triggered mid-duel

sources.supports: Broomless flight escaping Hogwarts (1998); Disarming Charm against Lockhart; blocking Harry and Disapparating (1997); duel with McGonagall and flight when Sprout, Flitwick and Slughorn joined; Occlumency, Legilimency; invented Levicorpus and Sectumsempra; doe Patronus; furious at being called a coward.

feats.claim: Escaped Hogwarts by leaping from a window and flying without a broom.
feats.citation: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows

feats.claim: At the Duelling Club, blasted Gilderoy Lockhart against a wall with the Disarming Charm.
feats.citation: Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets

feats.claim: Invented the Sectumsempra and Levicorpus spells.
feats.citation: Harry Potter and the Half-Blood Prince

notableResults.citation: Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets
notableResults.note: Duelling Club demonstration; disarmed him and blasted him into a wall.

notableResults.citation: Harry Potter and the Half-Blood Prince
notableResults.note: After Dumbledore's death, he blocked every attack Harry made, refused to strike back until Harry used Snape's own spells, then passed the gates and Disapparated.

notableResults.citation: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows
notableResults.note: McGonagall's attack began to overwhelm him. When Sprout, Flitwick and Slughorn joined in, he fled through a window, flying.

campaignTags.claim: Potions master and highly skilled Occlumens and Legilimens.
Inventor of Sectumsempra and Levicorpus; duelled McGonagall and Harry.
Flew without a broom when escaping Hogwarts in 1998.

unknowns: The cited source does not say whether he was holding back against McGonagall.
Non-verbal spellcasting: not stated by the cited source.
Removed in review: the claimed weakness 'vulnerable to provocation about Lily Potter'. The source supports pride and the coward taunt instead.

characters.continuity: Harry Potter books (Snape's Hogwarts student years, as the self-styled Half-Blood Prince)
characters.summary: The younger Snape, who styled himself the Half-Blood Prince. As a student he was already able to create new dark curses, hexes and jinxes, including Sectumsempra.

mechanisms: Not established by the cited source

weaknesses: Regularly bullied by James Potter and friends as a student
characters.formDifferences: Student-era Snape: relies on spells he invented himself, with none of his adult experience as a Death Eater, spy or Occlumens. The adult record's broomless flight, Apparition and later duels do not apply.

sources.supports: Self-styled 'Half Blood Prince' at school; capable of creating new dark spells as a student, mostly curses, hexes and jinxes; Sectumsempra gash on James's face; credited with Levicorpus and Sectumsempra; bullied by James Potter and friends.

feats.claim: Invented new dark spells as a student, including Sectumsempra, which left a gash on James Potter's face.
feats.citation: Harry Potter and the Half-Blood Prince / Deathly Hallows (memories)

campaignTags.claim: Student wizard who invented his own curses.
Created and cast new dark spells as a student.

unknowns: Muffliato and Langlock: recorded in his textbook, but the textbook page could not be opened in review and the cited page does not mention them.
Student-era duelling record beyond his clashes with the Marauders.

characters.summary: Sirius Black was an accomplished, reckless duellist and an unregistered Animagus (a huge black dog). He escaped Azkaban, fought Antonin Dolohov to a standstill, and was killed duelling Bellatrix Lestrange in the Department of Mysteries.

mechanisms: Animagus transformation (evaded Dementors in dog form)

weaknesses: Recklessness, which led to his death at Bellatrix's hands
mobility: Long-distance swimming (swam the North Sea after escaping Azkaban)

sources.supports: Unregistered Animagus (huge black dog); escape from Azkaban past the Dementors and swim across the North Sea; fought Dolohov to a standstill; killed in a duel with Bellatrix; recklessness; punched Lucius Malfoy.

feats.claim: Became an unregistered Animagus as a student, with James Potter and Peter Pettigrew.
feats.citation: Harry Potter and the Prisoner of Azkaban

feats.claim: Escaped Azkaban by slipping past the Dementors in dog form, then swam the North Sea to the mainland.
feats.citation: Harry Potter and the Prisoner of Azkaban / Goblet of Fire

feats.claim: Fought the 'extremely deadly' Antonin Dolohov to a standstill at the Department of Mysteries.
feats.citation: Harry Potter and the Order of the Phoenix

notableResults.citation: Harry Potter and the Order of the Phoenix
notableResults.note: Fought him to a standstill until Harry stunned Dolohov.

notableResults.citation: Harry Potter and the Order of the Phoenix
notableResults.note: Killed in a frenzied duel. An unknown spell struck him and he fell through the Veil.

campaignTags.claim: Accomplished wizard and Order of the Phoenix member.
Duelled Dolohov to a standstill and duelled Bellatrix.

unknowns: Effect of twelve years in Azkaban on his duelling.
Lucius Malfoy: the source describes only a punch, not a duel, so that 'inconclusive' result was removed in review. Shield-charm proficiency is also unsupported and was removed.

weaknesses: Not established by the cited source

characters.continuity: Fantastic Beasts films (The Crimes of Grindelwald, 1927)
characters.summary: Theseus Scamander, Newt's brother, is a First World War hero and Head Auror. At the 1927 Paris rally he led about fifty Aurors, survived a brief duel with Grindelwald and held a Shield Charm against Grindelwald's black fire.

mechanisms: Shield Charm sustained against Grindelwald's black fire

weaknesses: Overpowered when caught off guard (by Tina Goldstein)

sources.supports: Head Auror and First World War hero; gave the word to engage Grindelwald at the Père-Lachaise rally; brief duel with Grindelwald; Shield Charm held for a prolonged period; joint spell with Newt; commanded about 50 Aurors; overpowered only by Tina Goldstein when caught off guard; Apparition.

feats.claim: Led about fifty Aurors at Grindelwald's Père-Lachaise rally and gave the order to engage him.
feats.citation: Fantastic Beasts: The Crimes of Grindelwald

feats.claim: Held a Shield Charm against Grindelwald's black fire for a prolonged time, and cast a joint spell with Newt to deflect it.
feats.citation: Fantastic Beasts: The Crimes of Grindelwald

notableResults.citation: Fantastic Beasts: The Crimes of Grindelwald
notableResults.note: Survived a brief duel. Grindelwald escaped and Leta Lestrange was killed. Theseus and Newt survived with help from Flamel's General Counter-Spell.

notableResults.citation: Fantastic Beasts: The Crimes of Grindelwald

campaignTags.claim: Head Auror, strong in martial magic.
Sustained a Shield Charm against Grindelwald's fire and duelled him briefly.

unknowns: Events of The Secrets of Dumbledore (Erkstag imprisonment) were not checked against the cited source.

The wiki lists stealth among his Auror skills, but no specific stealth feat, so no stealth tag. The rally took place at Père-Lachaise, not the Lestrange Mausoleum. Broomstick flight and 'tactical positioning' are unsourced and were removed.
